desc:
💥🔫 Welcome to Battle Royale 🔫💥

👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite, and 👥 Join the Group for rewards and updates!

⚔️ Features
🔫 Instant respawn, no waiting, just fighting
🔥 DOUBLE, TRIPLE, QUAD KILLS and RAMPAGES
💀 Kill Shop: guns, power-ups, kill effects and shoot effects
😈 Get REVENGE on whoever took you out
🎯 Bounties on top players for bonus rewards
🏗️ Build walls and ramps to take the high ground
🛡️ Create or join a Clan and hit daily goals together
📜 Daily Quests and Daily Rewards
🎟️ Battle Pass Season 1 with exclusive rewards

💎 Premium Perks
❤️ 2x Health
🦘 Double Jump
🚀 Jetpacks, Grapple Hooks and more

📱 Fully supported on Mobile, Console and PC
